create_AzureAIOCRConfig: create an AzureAIOCRConfig instance to configure Azure AI OCR with Bearer token authentication
validate_environment_AzureAIOCRConfig: validate environment and build headers with Bearer token for Azure AI OCR using AZURE_AI_API_KEY
build_complete_url_AzureAIOCRConfig: build the complete Azure AI OCR endpoint URL from api_base with /providers/mistral/azure/ocr path
transform_ocr_request_AzureAIOCRConfig: transform an OCR request by converting document URLs to base64 data URIs before sending to Azure AI
async_transform_ocr_request_AzureAIOCRCo: asynchronously transform an OCR request by converting image URLs to base64 data URIs before sending to Azure AI
